result.summary:
Close-out round 5, realtime track, fix round 1: both majors are fixed and verified on one harness copy with the live plan cadence.

Harness: tools/live/invariants.mjs (e52f3dfd) adds --plan-cadence live|replay, default live. Each 60-s plan poll carries fetched_at = max(the snapshot's fetch, the last 10-min tick), as the relay serves it.

v2: the far 400-m bridge-ahead retraction now needs SFO's actual block-out. 'alloc', aEv and 'window' count only on lead-in close, and the round-3 two-signal veto stays. False 'arrival gone' re-docks at occupants that stay went to 0 on D (2), A-w (4) and G6 (4). bridge-ahead fell 33 -> 9, 19 -> 3 and 5 -> 0, and every remaining one was followed by the arrival driving in.

v11: standRealloc now fires only on another aircraft's arrival with an actual block-in at that stand more than 10 min after the occupant was last heard. False 'realloc' removals on A-w went 4 -> 0. Offline over all of segment A, same-stand removals went 9 -> 1, and that 1 is a proven tow.

Minors:
- Lock churn: an invalid lock is kept when releasing it would change nothing, and the conflict is logged once. D physUnlocks 278,960 -> 7.
- 2-2A: the root cause was the remote-stand 40-m disc, not a silent dock. A lateral limit fixes it: D gate_far 127,643/2 -> 28/1.
- Repositioned parking: this exposed a second defect, pushed aircraft that went silent being dropped after 75 s. On A-w before, 18 of 22 such drops were heard again at the same place. They are now kept parked.
- No-push re-undock: one re-signal per cancel on a squawk or callsign change. AAL402 lag 424 -> 199 frames.

Trade-offs: bridge.orphan D +1,333 frames / +13 keys and A-w +643 / +3; small first-contact rises in overlap.gnd and clear.taxi; repos side effects (ASA503 offpave at a mask gap, CFJNX 5 building frames).

Requests and hand-offs: C5.1 integration ring 82 / Garage A provenance; C5.2 owner decision on the opt-in --record-sfo-gates flag (not enabled, relay not restarted); C5.3 static pavement gap; C5.4 lead commit. v10 goes to the runtime-minors track.

The 'Round 5 (residuals)' section is appended to docs/requests/realtime_closeout.md. The final code is already in the lead's WIP commit 2b323d9; I made no commits, and no jobs of mine are running.

result.summary:
Round 5 runtime track (fix round 1). All 17 items are addressed: 13 fixed, 3 partly, 1 needs the owner. Nothing was committed by me (the lead's 02:59Z WIP commit already contains my earlier edits). No assets were rebuilt; I only started my own processes. Before = frozen tree at round start (`c5/runtime/root_before`), after = working tree; both arms used the same script copies (`c5/runtime/bscripts`). md5s are in NOTES.md and final_md5.txt.

**Bridges**
- **Neck notch fixed.** The corridor is now drawn as an outline that closes the drum / walkway / corridor junction. The drawn-mesh notch went from 0.92 m² to 0, and the corridor is 2.4 m wide everywhere.
- **Legacy dynamic cache fixed.** Frames drawing both the flat block and the fitted closure went from 7 of 11 to 0.
- **Conveyor end (aircraft c4 F3) fixed.** Belts with the end face inside the skin: 64/79 → 0 and 138/138 → 0.
- **bridges-6 is partly done.** `bldHit` now uses the integration footprint tiers with their height bands. The plan set is unchanged (3,331 made / 78 refused) and startup time did not grow. Moving walkway starts and drum limits onto the tiers changes walkway lengths, slopes and every vestibule, so I left it for a coordinated round with buildings (request R5.3, with the contact data).
- **R3.2.1 marked done and R3.2.2 withdrawn** in the closeout doc.
- **DEPARTURE_LEVELS A/B/C stay inferred.** This is the owner question.
- **Regression check:** the full bridge suite and bcheck2 give identical outputs before and after (0 issues).

**Environment**
- **SSR fixed.** The sky reflection is now subtracted with three's own specular occlusion. In the E9 rain render, pixels SSR darkens by more than 20 levels went from 186 to 42, only in the contact zones under bridges, aircraft and ground equipment.
- **Phone aureole fixed.** The quad is back to 2 radii, with the cut-off energy folded back into the core.
- **test_c3 mirror fixed.** The CPU check now draws the aureole the way the shader does; drawn energy is within 0.15 %.
- **Wet-runway rule fixed.** Re-read from the PDF: the 0–3 kt "calm" limit applies to the reported wind speed, not the tailwind component. On the 58 recorded METARs, non-West plans went from 7 to 8. The citation was also wrong ("§4b" is actually ¶7d) and is corrected in my files; the spec text needs the same fix (request R5.4).
- **paint.g encoding fixed.** The old renderer now reads the path tone with a coverage channel; the R3.1 request to static is revised.
- **Lakes fixed.** Visible water over the built terrain mesh is now 96.7 / 95.7 / 98.7 % (high tier) and 95.9 / 95.1 / 98.3 % (phone tier). The terrain mesh also builds faster than before.
- **Docs fixed:** night own-shadow wording corrected, env-12 closed.
- **live.html halo is partly done.** The shader change is in, and the render measured the halo effect, but `js/scene.js` must pack the lens flag (request R5.2).
- **Veil evidence is partly done.** On unclipped pixels, body vs surrounding glow reads 0.94–1.06 (no cut-out). The quarter-view hole could not be re-checked because the strobes were dark in both shots.
- **onFatal fixed:** `renderer3.fatal()` now calls the app's `R.onFatal` hook.
- **Gates:** all env gates pass (test_c3 now 37/37).
